remarks: Welcome to your new home in the heart of downtown Stamford. Meticulously updated 2-bedroom, 2 bath, Office/Den sunny apartment. Spacious living area with large windows full of natural light. Perfect for entertaining or relaxing at the end of a long day. Freshly painted, new floors, and large storage closet. Ensuite bathroom in master bedroom with walk-in closet. Secured building steps to popular restaurants, night life, the library, theatre, parks, UCONN, and so much more. 15-minute walk to the train station and easy access to 95. Ample Street Parking available. Parking is also available in the back parking lot from 5:30pm-7:30am during the week and 24 hours on the weekends.
